summary.one_liner: A curated reading list of papers, posts, talks, books, research groups and conferences on services engineering and cloud infrastructure.
summary.what_it_does: This is a link-style reading list rather than code, organized into sections: Papers, Posts, Presentations, Books, Research Groups, and Conferences. The papers section covers distributed systems and storage research such as Chubby, Bigtable, Spanner, Dynamo, MapReduce, the Google File System, Kafka, Dremel, Dapper, and the Raft consensus paper. The posts section covers reliability, incident response, alerting, postmortems, distributed systems correctness (e.g., clocks, partitions, the network), and load testing. Books cover human error, resilience engineering, monitoring and alerting, and production-ready software design. The README lists titles and authors only, without URLs, and says the author welcomes suggestions.
use_cases: learning incident response and postmortem practices
reading on reliability and resilience engineering
exploring large-scale storage and database design history
discovering conferences and research groups in systems engineering
notable: Mixes classic distributed systems papers (Chubby, Dynamo, Spanner, Raft) with practitioner essays on operations
Includes incident-response and postmortem material such as the Incident Command System and Heroku's incident response
Covers distributed systems correctness debates in posts by Kingsbury and Hale
Lists research groups and conferences alongside reading material
caveats: Contains titles and authors only, with no links or summaries in the README
Not maintained as software; updates depend on accepting suggestions
No license stated in the README
